Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Siya - 12 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rishabh points at the sky.]

Rishabh (laughing): "Exactly right."

[It starts to rain.]

Rishabh (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Hema (laughing): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
